name: Usenko TR-76 Geist Assualt Rifle
description_html:
A bullpup that fires 7.62x39mm, ported from COD.

Includes:

7.62x39\5.45x39\5.56x45 verison, using respective AK magazines.

2 types of handguard.

4 types of barrel extension.

Stockpad and comb modifications.

Models, textures, some of the animations and audioes are properties of Actvision.

Caliber variant texture created with help from DasIzzeta.

Please give clear indication of the author or origin when reuploading on other websites or publicly sharing this mod.

Please do not publish mod containing files or their variants with the suffix .bundle within this mod without permission.
